newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 13.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
* Time Warner Inc and Walt Disney Co both hit new highs on Monday in the latest sign that investors are returning to Hollywood stocks.
* EchoStar Communications Corp said it could run out of money to continue operating by the end of the second quarter unless it negotiates a new deal in the wake of its troubles with News Corp Ltd.
* General Electric Co's NBC has released its fall lineup of primetime shows, leaving some analysts skeptical about some moves but confident that the network will continue to dominate next season.
* Filmline International plans to begin shooting the movie "Free Money," starring Marlon Brando, in Montreal at the end of July.
* Sydney Pollack has agreed to develop the Columbia Pictures drama "The Ice Queen," starring Michelle Pfeiffer, sources told Variety.
* One of the questions most frequently asked on the Croisette this year is whether Ciby 2000, a unit of Bouygues, will be back in Cannes in 1998 and, if so, in what form.
* Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS led the pack in the Nielsen ratings on Sunday with the first of a three-part miniseries, "Mario Puzo's The Last Don."
